extras.real_size: 1990s five-door SUV, approx. 4.7 x 1.9 x 1.9 m (L x W x H incl. roof rails and spare wheel), wheel diameter 0.74 m
extras.notes: generic, brand-free 1990s sport utility vehicle with rounded body, wide grey side cladding and wheel arch flares, body-colour bumpers, clear-glass headlights, roof rails and a covered spare wheel on the tailgate; front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, seats, rear bench and steering wheel; blank number plates, no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
